title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30414: add sales budget navigation events
summary: Integration events are added to the Sales Budget Overview Matrix page so extensions can adjust Item Budget Name filters during record navigation operations.
key_points: Before and after events added around OnFindRecord and OnNextRecord navigation triggers
Extensions receive an Item Budget Name record variable to modify filters
Enables custom filtering logic during page navigation without modifying base code
quote: Extensions need to adjust Item Budget Name filters while the Sales Budget Overview Matrix navigates records
